meaning: One shared text chat for three or more people. Everyone sees every message.
clues: It is one shared text thread on your phone where family or friends trade messages.
Whatever one person sends, everyone in it sees.
Plans for a birthday party or a family trip are often made here.
If it gets too busy, you can mute it so your phone stops buzzing for each message.
It has two words. The first starts with G and the second starts with C.
assumes: A conference call is a phone call with many people
A mailing list sends one email to many people
A forum is a public website for posts

decoys.meaning: A phone call where three or more people talk at the same time.
A list of email addresses. One email sent to the list reaches everyone on it.
A website where people post messages about a topic, and strangers can read and reply.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Back in my day, a group meant a phone tree. You called one person, and they called the next.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Now one message reaches everyone. Tip: if it gets too busy, open the chat's settings and mute it.
